title: One cross-model coordinate chart for residual and KV transport
amendment: 02 corrected deterministic initialization; amendment 01 preserved as implementation pilot
scope: CPU real-LM paired-model screen; evaluates residual reconstruction plus next-token quality after translated KV handoff. Not a serving or broad cache-transfer benchmark.
hypothesis: A shared source/target coordinate chart with small role×layer View cores can transport residual states and both K/V cache tensors with quality approaching independent per-role/layer affine maps while using fewer actual serialized connector bytes.
physical_object: Frozen TinyStories GPT-Neo 1M source and 8M target model pair.
mirror_coordinate: Shared source projection A and target projection B, with role×layer 8×8 cores and biases; roles are residual, key and value.
logical_multiplicity: One physical cross-model chart serves residual feature maps and cache K/V handoffs across depth.
controls: independent affine map for each role×layer, fitted on same train token pairs
joint rank-8 shared A/B chart with per-role×layer core and bias

development.selection_metric: Implementation smoke only; fixed rank and all settings frozen before validation rows.

fresh.validation_pairs: same ordered pair; disjoint validation texts rows 512:640

training.seeding: Set Python and Torch seed before chart initialization and each batch schedule

paid_objects: shared A/B/core/bias or per-role/layer affine maps
source 1M weights required to produce cache

metrics: native target versus mapped-cache next-token NLL delta
success_gate: Shared chart NLL delta within 0.5 nat/token of independent affine and mean reconstruction MSE no more than 1.25× independent, while connector bytes ≤25% independent on all three seeds.
failure_gate: Miss quality gate on ≥2/3 seeds, or source+target deployment bytes exceed native target-only by >5%, or no connector byte advantage versus independent.
boundaries: Source model and target model full byte counts both reported; cache-translation does not erase source execution cost.
No GPU, fused-cache kernel, multi-token throughput or serving claim.
This is one model pair and disjoint text rows; not PA236 reproduction.
Mirror-specific interpretation requires comparison to the simpler independent affine maps and direct role-aware native mapping.

Amendment 01 (rows 512:768 / 384:512) is retained as an implementation pilot only because chart initialization occurred before the seed was set; amendment 02 uses new unseen validation rows and deterministic seed discipline.
